rationale: After 39 minutes in the trade and an initial excursion down to approximately $622.50, price has reclaimed the $623.50 breakdown level and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($623.57). Multiple 1-minute lows holding right at $623.50 show buyers defending that level as support rather than breaking down toward the $621.50 target, so exiting at breakeven removes risk as the short momentum stalls.
